sample_unit: GPT-4 responses to patient questions from otolaryngology guidelines

links.outcome: GPT-4 response quality (PEMAT-P total score) by language: English, Spanish, Mandarin
links.effect: Total PEMAT-P scores differed by language (Eta-Square 0.07, scores 73-77, P=0.03); understandability (P=0.17), actionability (P=0.44), and procedure-specific accuracy (P=0.22) did not differ.
links.quote: Total PEMAT-P scores differed between English, Mandarin, and Spanish GPT-4 generated responses depicting a moderate effect size of language, Eta-Square 0.07 with scores ranging from 73 to 77 (P-value = 0.03).

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4's performance (understandability, actionability, and accuracy) in translating otolaryngology patient education questions across English, Spanish, and Mandarin using PEMAT-P scoring.
